title: forward
summary: Run a supported dlnetwork forward pass.
description: `forward(net,X)` evaluates a RunMat `dlnetwork` compatibility object over numeric predictor data.
behaviors: Supports sequential feed-forward networks made from `featureInputLayer`, `fullyConnectedLayer`, `reluLayer`, `eluLayer`, `softmaxLayer`, `classificationLayer`, and `regressionLayer`.
Numeric matrix inputs are interpreted as observations in rows and predictors in columns.
`dlarray` inputs are unwrapped for normal execution, and the output is wrapped back into a `dlarray` preserving the input format metadata.
Inside `dlfeval`, host `dlarray` inputs and supported dlnetwork learnables are traced through fully-connected, ReLU, ELU, and softmax layers so scalar losses can be differentiated by `dlgradient`.

Name-value execution options, recurrent state outputs, branching DAG execution, custom layers, and provider-resident autodiff are not implemented in this slice and raise explicit compatibility errors.

examples.output: y is a numeric matrix with one row per observation.

gpu_residency: `forward` currently gathers plain provider-resident `gpuArray` inputs to host before evaluating the supported layer chain outside autodiff. GPU-backed `dlarray` autodiff is rejected because native Deep Learning provider tape kernels remain future acceleration work.
